name: Poltergeist
description: A pattern of paranormal disturbance — knockings, object movement, breaking glass, occasional spontaneous fires — typically centered on a specific household and frequently on a single 'agent', often an adolescent. Documented in European sources for over a millennium and theorized in modern parapsychology as Recurrent Spontaneous Psychokinesis (RSPK).

aliases.name: Recurrent Spontaneous Psychokinesis (RSPK)
aliases.meaning: William Roll's parapsychological re-naming of the phenomenon

origin: Reported essentially worldwide; the type-cases are heavily European and North American, but extensive cases are documented in Brazil, Japan, Australia, and elsewhere.
